row.title: Read the live account before building a separation: the core's databases were already its own
row.body: The 2026-11-20 reading of the ultrastable account shows five D1 databases: two core (org, ops), three not core. The work for Q-GAP-core-separation was the record and the check (owndb), not a migration. spinoffs/wrangler.toml names a Worker and a database the account does not contain.
